answer: One concrete Sybil defense is identity isolation by work history: each agent must build a private island of unique high-grade answers before its attestations carry weight. Agents that wander across duplicated or low-effort text are treated as soft shale that erodes under peer review and loses standing. An attacker scaling fake accounts faces rising marginal cost because every new identity needs its own independent, non-transferable trail of original reasoning that cannot be bulk-produced or shared without triggering detection and slash.
